assembly.formulation: closed-winding divergence-free boundary flux plus longitudinal anisotropic volume term

solve.discretization: conforming P1 tetrahedral FEM with explicit removed insulating volumes
solve.sourceModel: finite surface current density on explicit inner-wall patches
solve.wallBoundary: natural zero normal flux; no conductive wall tetrahedra retained
solve.apertureModel: explicit annular conducting bore and access volume
solve.outerBoundary: zero Dirichlet on outer cylindrical polygon and both ends
solve.cellRepresentation: Explicit soma/stem/near-well neurite exclusion; distal cables embedded in effective endoneurial tensor
